howToPlay.title: How to Play
items: Use arrow keys (↑↓←→) or swipe to move tiles
When two tiles with the same number touch, they merge
The merged value is added to your score
Reach the 2048 tile to win! You can keep playing after

tips.title: Strategy Tips
items: Keep your largest tile in a corner
Use only 2-3 directions to avoid scattering tiles
Never place the largest tile in the center
Use undo to recover from mistakes

whatIs.title: What is 2048?
whatIs.description: 2048 is a sliding puzzle game played on a 4×4 grid where you combine matching number tiles to reach the 2048 tile. Based on Gabriele Cirulli's original 2014 game, you slide tiles using arrow keys or swipes, merging identical numbers to create higher values. Simple to learn but increasingly strategic at higher numbers.

items.q: Can I keep playing after reaching 2048?
items.a: Yes! The game continues after you hit 2048. Keep pushing for 4096, 8192, or your highest possible score.

items.q: What should I do when I get stuck?
items.a: Game over occurs when no valid moves remain. Using the corner strategy — keeping your highest tile anchored in one corner — helps extend your game significantly.
Yes, your best score is automatically saved in browser localStorage and persists across sessions on the same browser and device.
